plan.encoding: RGBA8: R=base coefficient, G=white coefficient, B=0, A=coverage; straight alpha
plan.sampling: linear, no mipmaps, no repeat, no source_color conversion; padded frame region
plan.identity: sha256(render_version + LF + puzzle_id + LF + revision + LF + x + LF + y), first 8 hex digits modulo variants

usage: Developer-only PERF-A handover. Original project pencil; no third-party artwork. No palette copies. Excluded from player until PERF-B. Mipmaps/repeat/compression/source_color forbidden; linear filter; RGBA coefficients, straight alpha.

resources.materials: one shared shader; palette materials reused by future renderer
